code='''def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    # The nonzero runs in the template rows define the repeated sequences.
    seqs=[]
    for row in grid:
        vals=[v for v in row if v]
        if len(vals)>1:
            seqs.append(vals)
    mapping={}
    for seq in seqs:
        for i,v in enumerate(seq):
            mapping.setdefault(v,(seq,i))
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        for c,v in enumerate(row):
            if v and sum(x!=0 for x in row)==1:
                seq,i=mapping[v]
                start=c-i
                for j,x in enumerate(seq):
                    cc=start+j
                    if 0<=cc<w: g[r][cc]=x
    return g
'''
